sentences.text:
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Shweta Singh Rana
Hon'ble Raj Beer Singh,J.
1.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant as well as learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the entire record.
No one has appeared on behalf of the informant despite calling the case in revised list.

2. The present bail application has been filed by the applicant in case crime No. 369/2018, under Sections 363, 366, 368, 376, 120-B IPC & Section 3/4 of POCSO Act, police station Sachendi,
District Kanpur Nagar with the prayer to enlarge the applicant on bail.
3.
It has been argued by learned counsel for the applicant that the applicant-accused is innocent and he has not committed any offence.
It was submitted that applicant is not named in the first information report.
According to prosecution version, victim girl was enticed away by co-accused Munna and he left her at railway station Jhansi.

Learned counsel submitted that victim girl was Raju Ahirwar vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 19 May, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/193573596/
1 married with applicant by one police official posted at Jhansi railway station.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
As per school record,
at the time of alleged incident, the age of victim has been shown about 16 and a half years but her ossification test has not been conducted and in fact she is a major girl.
Learned counsel has referred that statements of victim, recorded under Sections 161 and 164 Cr.P.C., and submitted that now victim has married with one Suraj Prajapati and she was residing with him.

In her statement,
recorded under Section 164 Cr.P.C., victim girl has not made any allegation of physical exploitation against the applicant and merely it was alleged that applicant used to assault her.
It was further submitted that said co-accused Munna, Saddam Hussain, Ravi and Aftab have already been enlarged on bail by coordinate Benches of this Court, copies of which, are available on record.

Lastly, it was submitted that the applicant is in judicial custody since 21.01.2022, having no criminal history, and that in case, applicant is enlarged on bail, the applicant will not misuse the liberty of bail.
4. Learned A.G.A. has opposed the prayer for bail.

5. Considering the submissions of learned counsel for the parties, nature of accusations, period of custody and all attending facts and circumstances of the case, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, the Court is of the view that a case for bail is made out.
Hence, the bail application is hereby allowed.

6. Let the applicant Raju Ahirwar involved in the aforesaid crime be released on bail on furnishing a personal bond and two local sureties each of the like amount to the satisfaction of court concerned subject to the following conditions:
i.
The applicant will not tamper with the evidence during trial.
ii. The applicant will not pressurize/intimidate the prosecution witnesses.
iii. The applicant will appear before the trial court on the date fixed, unless personal presence is exempted.
iv. The applicant will not try to contact, threat or otherwise influence the complainant or any of the witness of the case.
7. In case of breach of any of the above condition, the court concerned shall be at liberty to cancel the bail of applicant, in accordance with law.
